notes.title: Livestream of the scariest horror game based on Lovecraft
notes.notes:
Attention Lovecraft and Bioshock enthusiasts!

Tune into our livestream during Steam Next Fest as we dive into our horror game. Even we're kept on edge, never knowing when or where a monster might emerge.

We will be livestreaming on October 9 (Monday) at 13:00 PM PST / 10:00 PM CET.
Check your schedules and join us online!
